arStrings.szText: Spending {c_important}Dominance{/c} to {c_important}Summon{/c} a demon reduces the {c_important}Wrath{/c} cost of your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills by {c_number}[SF_1*100|%|]{/c} and increases all of your damage by {c_number}[SF_0*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds.
All damage is increased and {c_important}Wrath{/c} cost for {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills is reduced.
